subject: session: remove distributed tasks limitation from upgrade (#56773)
summary: Change removes the upgrade-time hard block (`checkDistTask`) that previously `Fatal`’d when `tidb_enable_dist_task` was ON or `mysql.tidb_global_task` contained nonterminal tasks; `upgrade()` now proceeds without that gate. Bootstrap/upgrade DDL on system schemas already disables distributed reorg via `hasSysDB(job)` (forces `IsDistReorg=false`), so this change does not enable dist-task execution for the upgrade’s own system-table DDL. No Blocker/High issues found in session/bootstrap behavior; later history up to `upstream/master` does not reintroduce this restriction.
